svg.title: Responsive interaction policies build user trust in autonomous human-robot collaboration
svg.desc: Graphical abstract: pilot study (n=24) using a Misty II robot. Responsive policy participants reported 18-point higher experienced trust than reactive-policy participants on a 0-100 scale. The trust advantage attenuates when language-mediated communication breaks down.
svg.text: PILOT STUDY · N = 24 · AUTONOMOUS MISTY II · IN-PERSON COLLABORATION
Responsive interaction policies build user trust

text.tspan: the trust advantage attenuates when language-mediated communication breaks down — a boundary condition for autonomy in real settings.

svg.text: Heron & Lau (2026) · Misty II illustration after Misty Robotics
